items.definition:
risky; dangerous
Working with these chemicals is hazardous.

slight, not central
The difference in performance was marginal.

worthy of respect
He comes from a respectable family.

providing shade; of questionable character
The park has many shady trees where you can relax.

not taut or held tightly; lacking in activity or energy
The rope went slack.

smooth and slippery; operating or performing with great efficiency and skill
The road was slick with ice.

occurring as a result of a sudden inner impulse
Her laughter was spontaneous and infectious.

sexually attracted to both men and women
The character in the show is openly bisexual.

compulsory
Attendance at the meeting is compulsory for all staff.

daring
It was a daring attempt to climb the mountain without ropes.

dietary
She has some strict dietary restrictions.

without meaning or purpose
The conversation felt completely meaningless.

happening or done before the usual or proper time
The baby was premature, born at 30 weeks.

reacting quickly and positively
The company is very responsive to customer feedback.

relating to or affected by tides
The beach is affected by strong tidal currents.

appropriate or suitable in the circumstances
That was an apt description of the situation.

forbidding or uninviting in appearance
The news was grim, indicating a difficult road ahead.

extremely active or energetic
The child was hyper after eating too much candy.

relating to or characteristic of poetry or poets
Her writing style is very poetic and expressive.

relating to archaeology
They discovered an important archaeological site.

stylish and elegant
She looked very chic in her new dress.

shared by all members of a community
They share a communal kitchen in the dormitory.

causing great damage or failure
The party was a disastrous failure.

working for different companies at different times rather than being permanently employed by one company
He works as a freelance graphic designer.

designed to find out the truth about something
The newspaper published an investigative report on the scandal.

grossly fat or overweight
The doctor warned him that he was becoming obese.

relating to sensation or the physical senses
The child had a heightened sensory perception, noticing every small detail.

not easily convinced; having doubts or reservations
He remained skeptical about the politician's promises.

relating to acting, actors, or the theater
The actor's performance was very theatrical and dramatic.

not able to be foreseen or known in advance; uncertain
The weather in this region is very unpredictable.

carried by air
The disease is airborne.

in a state of complete confusion and disorder
The traffic was chaotic after the accident.

relating to the center or most important part
The focal point of the discussion was climate change.

Deserving of honor and respect.
He made an honorable decision to resign.

Strange or odd.
He had a peculiar habit of talking to himself.

mentally healthy; reasonable
Despite the stress, she managed to stay sane.

full of energy and enthusiasm; bright and striking
The city has a vibrant nightlife.

intoxicated with alcohol
He was arrested for drunken driving.

no longer existing
Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.

given as an honor, without the usual requirements
She received an honorary degree from the university.

not producing any significant or desired effect
The old methods proved to be ineffective.

having qualities traditionally associated with men
He had a deep, manly voice.

unable to speak; silent
He remained mute throughout the interrogation.

unnecessary because it is obvious or already known
His needless comments only made the situation worse.

arranged or existing for the present, possibly to be changed later
They issued a provisional license for the new restaurant.

of little value or importance
Don't worry about such trivial matters.

not officially authorized or confirmed
This is an unofficial translation of the document.

unclear; covered with soft, short hair
The old photograph was a bit fuzzy.

relating to a style of architecture or literature
The old church had a beautiful Gothic archway.

not accurate; incorrect or untrue
The report contained several inaccurate figures.

not having or showing the necessary skills to do something successfully
The new manager proved to be completely incompetent.

no longer produced or used; out of date
Typewriters are now largely obsolete.

relating to the eye or sight
The new telescope has advanced optic lenses.

having or showing no pity or compassion for others
The ruthless dictator showed no mercy.

relating to an occupation or employment
She is studying at a vocational college.

relating to nutrition
This cereal is a good nutritional source.

seeming reasonable or probable
Her excuse sounded plausible.

a brilliant red color
She wore a dress of a deep scarlet color.

logical and consistent
His argument was coherent and well-reasoned.

stylish and modern; having a strong, earthy smell
She wore a funky hat to the party.

appearing or occurring at intervals
The doctor recommended periodic check-ups.

extending throughout a state
The new law will have a statewide impact.

relating to high mountains
We enjoyed the stunning alpine scenery during our hike.

relating to water
Many aquatic plants grow in this pond.
